content:
noah: Just completed SSO onboarding + invited team. Followed the Python quickstart verbatim but the first API call returns 402 Payment Required even though the web UI shows 'Trial enabled'. Anyone else seen the UI show active while the API still gates?

reena: Was the org created via SAML SSO or SCIM provisioning?

noah: SAML SSO. Used the starter flask sample and exported REDWOOD_KEY. Minimal curl below.

noah: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \n  -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hello"}]}'

HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required
Content-Type: application/json

{"error":{"type":"billing_required","message":"workspace payment required","billing_url":"https://app.redwood.ai/workspaces/org-XYZ/billing"}}
```

devex-oncall: Can you GET /v1/workspaces/:id (or /v1/workspaces/me) and paste state? The gateway logs often show provisioning vs active mismatch.

noah: GET /v1/workspaces/me returns {"id":"org-XYZ","state":"provisioning"} even though the UI shows trial and a credit card modal never popped up.

reena: This matches a provisioning race we've seen with SSO orgs: the frontend flips the workspace to "onboarded" once the SSO assertion completes, but backend billing/account provisioning can still be in progress. The API returns billing_required until the async job finishes.

noah: Also noticed the Python SDK (1.2.0) in the starter enables auto-retries by default. The gateway logs show three POSTs in quick succession from the sample, which made the UX worse (multiple 402s + confusing errors in logs).

infra-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-90  https://go.redwood.ai/inc/INC-2026-90 (sso onboarding/provisioning race)

reena: Short-term: add an explicit pre-flight check in quickstarts: GET /v1/workspaces/:id and require state=="active" before emitting user-facing requests. We'll also surface a clearer message in the sample like "Workspace initializing — please wait" instead of spamming the API.

noah: I can open a tiny PR to the python starter that polls workspaces/me with exponential backoff and prints a friendly hint. Happy to include a flag to disable in CI.

starter-bot: Issue opened: redwood-inference/starter#512  "quickstart: wait for workspace active before first API call" (with repro steps)

reena: Long-term: SDK should provide a helper wait_for_workspace_ready(workspace_id, timeout) so apps don't have to copy/paste. We'll track that in SDK backlog.

devex-oncall: Merged PR #5047 to starter and published python SDK 1.3.0-beta with helper. Quickstart updated on main with the pre-flight check.

noah: Updated my local sample to call the helper and confirmed: first call now succeeds once state flips to active. Thanks y'all! :tada:

reena: Adding a note to the onboarding docs that SSO customers may see a short provisioning delay and to check /workspaces/me if they hit a 402. Closing for now; reopen if it recurs. :+1:
